chapter: Pianists, Basie, Lil Armstrong and closing
title: Joe Williams leaves for Basie's small group at the Brass Rail
summary: Joe Williams left Saunders's management for a Count Basie small group with Clark Terry and Buddy DeFranco at the Brass Rail.

story.theme_name: Singers and the musicians who accompanied them
story.community_name: Joe Williams: the singer with Basie

blocks.x: So -- and then, as the years go by, then I visit with him every time I get a chance, to catch up. Then the Joe Williams incident, Joe Williams was with me, I was managing him at that particular time. And then he left me and went with the Count Small group.
Yeah, the Count Small group was playing down on Randolph.
Randolph Street, right, at the Brass Rail.
Right. And then he was there, and then we used to --
I didn't know that Joe worked with him at that point.
And then Basie had put the big band --
And then the big band, and then Joe --
But he had worked with a small band.
With a small group, right. Clark Terry was in the group.
I'd like to hear them. They made one record, but I've never --
They didn't do too much recording.
They just took one album for Norman Granz, but I've never heard it, and it's very rare.
